Name: Cute Junimo Chest - Pink
Author: NasikaSakura
Description:
This is a recoloring and retexturing meant for color compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]"Cute Valley - Pink" by Rosalie/ Rosiea[/url]﻿. 

However, by no means is this mod limited to being used only in conjunction to Cute Valley! 
It just means that this mod contains ONLY the two colorizations of the Junimo Chest that were missing from the aforementioned at the time of creation. ♡ 

Please use with the current version of [url=https://smapi.io/]Smapi [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿! 

Enjoy. :3
